response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS n FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), tot AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total, AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM per_type), shares AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.n, p.n * 1.0 / tot.total AS share, tot.avg_n FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN tot) SELECT SUM(n) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(n - avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM shares WHERE n > avg_n

assumptions.assumption: An 'analysed trade record' is one advancedbehavior row that joins (inner) to an existing transactionrecord and its trader. Each such row counts once toward its trader's tradekind.
The average across trader types is the mean of the per-type counts, taken only over types that appear in the joined data. The overall total is the sum of those counts.
Share is each type's count divided by the overall total, as an unrounded fraction between 0 and 1 rather than a percentage.
